exceptions.rationale: The current matches are Django and Alpine templates, not JSF; Semgrep mistakes constant Alpine assignments for escape=false while Django autoescaping remains enabled.
The public embed intentionally supports arbitrary parent sites and sends only a non-sensitive resize tuple containing type, slug, and bounded layout height.
The CMS editor rejects empty, __proto__, prototype, and constructor path components before assignment and uses own-property checks at every traversal step.
AWS SNS SignatureVersion 1 mandates SHA-1 solely for verifying an AWS-signed envelope after certificate URL and topic allowlisting; version 2 uses SHA-256.
Browser CSP reports cannot carry Django CSRF tokens; the endpoint is POST-only, diagnostic, non-mutating, 4 KiB bounded, field-sanitized, and rate-limited.
The safe-string wrapper is constructed only after Bleach applies explicit tag, attribute, scheme, and iframe-host allowlists, with malicious-input regression tests.
Every current matched Django POST form explicitly renders csrf_token inside the form; Semgrep partially parses these templates and reports the protected forms.
The local reset command formats only database-introspected identifiers after backend quote_name escaping; SQL identifiers cannot be supplied as bind parameters.
SNS transport validates the exact AWS HTTPS host and port, enforces TLS 1.2 with certificate and hostname checks, disables redirects and proxies, and bounds responses.
The remaining compatibility loader constructs canonical module names only after matching a closed constant allowlist of legacy application roots.
The local reset command uses psycopg sql.Identifier or backend quote_name for database-controlled identifiers and has no request or remote input surface.
